skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept and characteristics of PPP, the origin of PPP, and its role in infrastructure development and public service provision.
Understand the bidding and contract management process in PPP projects.
Identify, assess, and mitigate risks in PPP projects.
Evaluate the financial effectiveness of PPP projects.
Understand and analyze the government's management of PPP projects in Vietnam.
Conduct research, analyze, synthesize, and evaluate PPP-related content.
Work independently and in groups, identify and solve problems related to PPP.
Analyze and evaluate practical situations related to PPP.
Present and discuss topics related to PPP.
